subject: Renewal + Capacity: billing transfer and PO clarification for CedarFlow
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cedarflow.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@cedarflow.io
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity commit — billing owner change and PO question

Hi Vivek,

Quick one as we lock the renewal: CedarFlow is ready to sign the 12-month capacity commitment+20% uplift you proposed. Our procurement team needs two clarifications before we route the PO:

- Who will be listed as the payee on the invoice (we currently have invoices going to CedarFlow Inc., EIN 12-3456789). Our AP team is requesting the payee to be changed to "CedarFlow Cloud Ops LLC" for this contract. Is that supported?
- Please confirm whether Redwood can accept our single consolidated PO for the commitment + overage buffer (we'll attach the signed PO once we get your reply).

Also attached is a preliminary W9 for our records (they asked for a Redwood W9, but happy to accept Redwood's if you can send). We can put the PO on Net45 once the payee and entity details are confirmed.

Can you loop in billing so we can avoid delays? We are aiming to have everything routed to finance by next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Finance, CedarFlow
alex.chen@cedarflow.io
Attachment: CedarFlow_signed_PO_8421.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cedarflow.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commit — billing owner change and PO question

Alex — thanks for the note and congrats on the commit. I’ve looped in Marissa (billing ops) and Ben (sales ops) to confirm details. Quick answers up front:

- Payee change: We can invoice a different legal payee, but we need a signed PO that exactly matches the payee name and EIN. If the payee is "CedarFlow Cloud Ops LLC" please include that name + EIN on the PO.
- Consolidated PO: Yes, Redwood accepts a single PO covering both the committed capacity and the uplift/overage buffer. Please mark line items to reference deal ID DEAL-8421 in the PO.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm the invoicing flow and whether we need a separate billing entity record for the new payee? Also, can you send Redwood's W9 so Alex can attach it back to their AP team?

Next steps I propose:
1) CedarFlow sends finalized PO with exact payee name + EIN
2) Redwood returns completed W9 and invoice template for AP
3) Finance schedules first invoice on the renewal effective date; Net45 can be set if compliant with our AR policy

Alex — happy to jump on a quick 15 min call if it helps speed this.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@cedarflow.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commit — billing owner change and PO question

Hi all,

Thanks Vivek. Alex — quick checklist from billing:

- We can invoice "CedarFlow Cloud Ops LLC" provided the PO matches that legal name and an EIN is supplied on the PO.
- Please add a billing contact email and AP phone on the PO (finance@cedarflow.io is fine).
- We will route the first invoice on the renewal effective date. Net45 is accepted for Enterprise customers on approved credit; I have flagged this to AR team — please confirm the final PO and we’ll run the credit check (should be routine).

Attached: Redwood_W9.pdf (for your AP), and a sample invoice template to make routing smoother.

Attachment: Redwood_W9.pdf (for your AP)
Attachment: Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Ben — can you update the deal record with the new payee name and attach the signed PO once Alex returns it? I’ll hold Net45 pending credit confirmation and the signed PO.

Alex — once you send the updated PO I’ll confirm acceptance and kick off credit.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cedarflow.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@cedarflow.io
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commit — billing owner change and PO question

Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the fast answers. We’ve updated the PO to show payee as "CedarFlow Cloud Ops LLC" with EIN 98-7654321, and included the billing contact. I attached the signed PO and our W-9 for your records.

Please confirm once you have the PO in the system and when the credit check is complete. If Net45 requires anything else from our side (bank reference, credit app), let me know and I’ll push to AP.

Attachment: CedarFlow_signed_PO_8421.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: CedarFlow_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Alex
